structure.unit: Statewide Emergency Medical Services System and Services

law.catch_line: Emergency treatment of fire, police, and search and rescue dogs
law.text: The Advisory Board shall, in consultation with the Board of Veterinary Medicine, develop guidelines and guidance for the provision of emergency treatment of fire, police, and search and rescue dogs injured in the line of duty and the transportation of such dogs by an emergency medical services vehicle to a veterinary care facility equipped to provide emergency treatment to such dog.
